import os
import asyncio
from cyhole.solscan import SolscanV2

async def fetch_token_price_history():
    api_key = os.getenv('SOLSCAN_API_KEY')
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("SOLSCAN_API_KEY environment variable not set")
    
    token_address = "EPjFWaLb3odcccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"  # Example: USDC
    
    solscan = SolscanV2(api_key=api_key)
    price_data = await solscan.get_token_price_history(token_address)
    
    return price_data

if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = asyncio.run(fetch_token_price_history())
    print(result)
